title: derris elegans var. korthalsiana
intro: Derris elegans var. korthalsiana, commonly known as the Malay teasel or Java teasel, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which help in wound healing and the treatment of skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of D. elegans var. korthalsiana include its use as a natural insecticide and its ability to treat various ailments like fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and provide a range of health benefits.
